mods.name: LaTeX Book
mods.description: Replaces the book and quill screen with a LaTeX editor and typeset preview. Written books containing math are rendered with LaTeX too.

releases.notes:
First release of **LaTeX Book**, a client-side Fabric mod for **Minecraft 26.3**.

![editor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jaandersonck/mc-latex/main/docs/editor.png)

### Features
- Replaces the book and quill screen with a LaTeX source editor and a live typeset preview.
- `$...$` inline math, `$$...$$` / `\[...\]` display math, `\$` for a literal dollar. Long pages auto-shrink to fit.
- Parse errors are highlighted in red on the page and explained under the editor.
- Written books and lecterns render pages that contain math with LaTeX; other pages stay vanilla.
- Pages are stored as plain LaTeX source, so books work on any server and with players who don't have the mod.

### Install
Drop `latex-book-1.0.0.jar` into your `mods` folder. Requires Fabric Loader ≥ 0.19.5 and Java 25+. Fabric API is **not** required. JLaTeXMath is bundled.
